Privacy Policy

Last updated: 25 October 2026.

Beg Your Garden (ABN 94 405 029 650) (“we”, “us”) respects your privacy and handles personal information in line with the Australian Privacy Principles under the Privacy Act 1988 (Cth). This policy explains what we collect through this website and how it is used.

What we collect

When you request a quote we collect the details you enter in the form: your name, email address, phone number, property address and suburb, property size, the service you need, whether it is a one-off or regular job and how often, any job notes, any photos you attach, and whether you ticked the referral tick box. If you call or email us we keep the contact details and notes needed to quote and deliver the service.

How we use it

We use your information to prepare quotes, schedule and deliver services, send reminders and service updates, and respond to your enquiries. We may also send occasional service-related messages (for example seasonal lawn care reminders); you can opt out at any time by replying or contacting us.

How it is stored and shared

Form submissions are captured by our customer relationship management system (LeadConnector / GoHighLevel) and stored securely. We do not sell your information. We share it only with service providers who help us run the business (such as our CRM and messaging platforms) and only for the purposes above, or where required by law.

Referral partners (only if you tick the box)

Our quote form has an optional tick box. If you tick it and we cannot help you (for example you are outside our service area, we are fully booked, or you need a service we do not offer), you agree that we may pass your name, phone number, email address and suburb to a trusted local business that can help. We may receive a referral fee from that business. We do not pass on your job notes or photos. If you leave the box unticked, your details stay with us and are not shared with any referral partner. We record whether the box was ticked and the date and time you submitted the form. You can withdraw this consent at any time by emailing team@begyourgarden.com, and we will not refer your details after that.

Cookies and analytics

This site may use cookies and tracking scripts to understand how visitors use it and to attribute enquiries. You can disable cookies in your browser settings; the site will still work.

Access and corrections

You can ask to see, correct or delete the personal information we hold about you by emailing team@begyourgarden.com or calling 0411 638 432. We will respond within a reasonable time.
